mobbin:98d1b7e8-cff5-47a9-84e7-278eb2650.summary: During a live recording, the host taps 'Mark Clip' to mark a moment, a short pop-up message confirms it, and the button counts the marks so far.
steps: Recording in progress, with a 'Mark Clip' button
Pop-up confirms the clip; button now says 'Mark Clip (3)'
steal: One tap on 'Mark Clip' marks a moment without a form, while the 'REC' sign and upload progress stay on screen (screen 1).
A short pop-up message gives the exact time in the recording ('00:03:59 Clip created from marker') and can be closed (screen 2).
The button counts the marks so far ('Mark Clip (3)'), so the host can keep track even when marks overlap (screen 2).
The People panel shows how much of each participant's video has uploaded ('720p 97% uploaded') next to 'REC' (screen 1).
mobbin:98d1b7e8-cff5-47a9-84e7-278eb2650.fit: Recording: faculty could mark moments during a live session, and the marks would land in the existing marker row on the SRV timeline. The counter helps with the known problem of overlapping marks.

mobbin:97d3f401-44c3-430b-ac7e-11e365f63.summary: The host opens 'Invite people' with link or email and roles. A red banner says 'An error occurred, please try again later' with no cause or recovery.
steps: Role menu: Audience, Guest, or Producer
Red error message over the invite dialog
steal: Invite roles use plain words such as Audience, Guest, and 'Producer not recorded' (screen 2).
An audio-only note says 'Video won't be recorded…' and offers 'Switch to video recording' (screen 1).
avoid: A generic 'An error occurred, please try again later' names no failed action, cause, or retry, so non-technical faculty cannot recover mid-session.
mobbin:97d3f401-44c3-430b-ac7e-11e365f63.fit: Recording: invite and check-in failures outside the SRV must name the action and next step, not a dismiss-only banner.

mobbin:7a5685e7-9d0d-44c5-afe1-4cdc3eef5.summary: The host opens a Riverside studio, chooses 'Start recording' or 'Run test recording', waits through a countdown, then sees live 'REC' with 'Stop', 'Mark Clip' and upload progress.
steps: Studio ready with 'Start' and invite tile
Record menu: start or test recording
steal: The record button offers 'Start recording' or 'Run test recording' on the same red control (screen 2).
A large countdown appears on the video with 'Starting…' before 'REC' begins (screen 3).
'Stop' shows elapsed time (00:27) and stays separate from 'Leave' (screen 4).
The header shows 'REC' and upload progress, and People shows each host's upload ('720p / 93% uploaded') (screen 4).
avoid: An empty 'Invite people' tile sits as large as the live feed, which competes with monitoring when starting.
mobbin:7a5685e7-9d0d-44c5-afe1-4cdc3eef5.fit: Recording: models control-room start and stop outside the SRV with optional test, countdown, and 'REC' plus upload progress. 'Mark Clip' feeds the SRV timeline markers.
